evidence.quote: To solve this problem, we develop three novel modules: (i) a domain alignment module is designed to align the feature distributions between different domains of each modality; (ii) a cross-modal alignment module aims to map both video and query features into a joint embedding space and to align the feature distributions between different modalities in the target domain; and (iii) a specific alignment module tries to obtain the fine-grained similarity between a specific frame and the given query for optimal localization.
